policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The issue-682 client changes add critic-rating parsing helpers and OSD/tag-pipeline coverage. The official CI client coverage gate measured 2,811/3,196 (87.954%) on this exact tree.

The advanced per-category Spoiler Guard reveals add SpoilerNextUnwatchedService (bounded next-unwatched boundary cache), the CategoryReveal mask in SpoilerFieldStripFilter, and seven admin config keys; the categorization fail-closed fix settled the instrumented scope at 53,294 lines (from 53,174 on main). Six clean Release coverage runs on this exact tree observed 43,587-43,595 covered lines. Cobertura diffs between clean runs show the flapping lines are exclusively pre-existing timing-dependent async paths untouched by this diff: Platform/PlatformInstalledManifestFileReader, Platform/PlatformProviderInvocationService, Platform/PlatformProviderRegistryOrchestrator, and Services/SpoilerGuard/SpoilerSeerrPendingPromoter worker branches. The floor 43,587/53,294 = 81.786% still exceeds the previous required floor 43,470/53,174 = 81.750%, so the ratchet moves upward; the eight-line envelope is 0.015pp, far inside the 0.15pp policy bound.
